name: framed-portrait
description: A picture of a named person or artwork in a carved gilt frame (or a halftone polaroid or bare photo, opening with an iris) with a slow push in, optionally zooming into a point such as the eyes; with `empty` the picture leaves the frame; then a red stamp like "GONE" slams on and the frame thuds down. Like the Mona Lisa frame with the "GONE" stamp in the reference reel.
useWhen: the speaker names a person, a portrait or a famous artwork
someone disappears, is lost, found, wanted or remembered
a stamp such as GONE, FOUND, WANTED or 1911 should land on a face
